reset_contract.interface_mask: flag_interface_open = i_rstn & reg_release_done; external o_rx_ready/o_tx_valid and internal shell_rx_valid/shell_tx_ready are zero-blocked until open

reset_contract.stale_valid_boundary: no epoch port exists, so a producer that holds a pre-reset valid across reset is outside the proved contract
reset_contract.table_recovery: all 1024 entries must be reloaded after every reset
reset_contract.normal_operation: arithmetic, 38-bit interface, fixed multipliers, initiation interval, and immediate cancellation semantics are unchanged; reload is a separate recovery window
